The plate looks like a dinner plate (about 26 cm). On it is a small pile of roasted or fried potato chunks with ketchup, covering roughly 9×8 cm. That works out to about 130 g of potatoes plus about 20 g of ketchup.

Fried potatoes run around 150 kcal per 100 g, giving about 195 kcal. The ketchup adds about 20 kcal. That totals roughly 215 kcal, which I've rounded to 220.
